newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close up on gains by leading shares.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close up on gains by leading shares.

text.p: Dhaka stocks ended 1.61 percent up on Wednesday amid retail buying pressure for leading shares, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index closed 38.94 points or 1.61 percent higher at 1,826.58 on a turnover of 40.3 million taka. Of 78 traded issues 62 gained and 14 lost.

"The blue scrips were in high demand as the market seems to have stabilised at justified levels after corrections," one broker said. Leasing Company IDLC gained 173 taka to 5,158, Singer Bangladesh rose 201 to 13,777 and Square Pharmaceuticals was up 24 to 1,347.
